mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in the federal funds rate above 0.25% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing real interest rates and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.25% in a month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent unemployment above 9.0% signals labor market slack suppressing wage growth and corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic weakness persists.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate over the prior three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE increases over the prior three months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production below 92.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and earnings expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 92.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous inflation acceleration above 2.0% (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate increase above 0.25% (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening to combat inflation, increasing real rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both CPIAUCSL > 2.0% and FEDFUNDS > 0.25%, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market slowdown (HOUST below 550.0 thousand units) reduces construction activity and consumer confidence, weakening overall demand and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls below 550.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
